title: Wavefunction Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the wavefunction of the ground state of helium, including spin.

title: Energy Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the ground state energy E_0 for helium.

title: Expectation Value
description: Important Criteria: The student must compute the expectation value of the electron interaction term correctly.

title: Interaction Energy
description: Important Criteria: The student must estimate the electron interaction energy and express it in electron volts.

title: Final Energy Comparison
description: Important Criteria: The student must add the interaction energy to the initial energy and compare it to the experimental value.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign errors in energy calculations, particularly in the interaction energy.

title: Normalization Check
description: Optional Criteria: The student may check the normalization of the wavefunction to ensure it is correctly normalized.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
